sql:
SELECT from_bank, from_account, MIN(transaction_id) AS anchor_transaction_id,
COUNT(*) AS positive_transactions
FROM IBM_AML.hi_large_transactions
WHERE is_laundering=1 AND transaction_time >= TIMESTAMP '2022-08-03 00:00:00'
AND transaction_time < TIMESTAMP '2022-08-04 00:00:00'
AND (from_bank <> to_bank OR from_account <> to_account)
GROUP BY from_bank, from_account ORDER BY anchor_transaction_id LIMIT 3
selection_bias: Uses ground truth to select positive accounts; not blind validation
